extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store and on the extensions page. Max 75 characters. Keep the brand name TabNest.

extShortName.description: Short name shown under the toolbar icon. Max 12 characters.

extDescription.message: Save, group and restore your tabs in one click. Free up memory and never lose a session again.

commandSaveSession.message: Save all open tabs as a session

popupSearchPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text in the search box at the top of the popup.

buttonSaveSession.description: Button label. A session is a saved set of tabs.

buttonRestore.description: Button label. Opens all tabs of a saved session again.

buttonDelete.description: Button label. Deletes a saved session.

sessionSaved.description: Toast shown after saving. count is a number, session_name is the name the user gave.

sessionRestoreConfirm.message: Restore $count$ tabs from $session_name$? Your current window stays open.
sessionRestoreConfirm.description: Confirmation dialog before restoring a session.

lastSaved.description: Small grey text under a session. $1 is a relative time like "5 minutes ago".

memoryFreed.message: You freed about $MEGABYTES$ MB of memory today.
memoryFreed.description: Stats line in the popup footer.

workspaceCreate.description: Menu item. A workspace is a named group of sessions.

workspaceEmpty.message: This workspace is empty. Drag a session here to add it.
workspaceEmpty.description: Empty state text inside a workspace.

proPrice.message: Upgrade to Pro for $$4.99 per month
proPrice.description: Upsell button. $$ is a literal dollar sign. Keep the price and currency as is.

proPriceYearly.description: Second line under the upsell button.

contextMenuSaveTab.description: Right-click menu item on a page.

contextMenuSaveAll.message: Save all tabs in this window
contextMenuSaveAll.description: Right-click menu item on a page.

settingsAutoSave.message: Save my tabs automatically every $minutes$ minutes
settingsAutoSave.description: Checkbox label on the options page.

settingsSync.message: Sync sessions across devices with your Chrome account

errorQuota.message: Sync storage is full ($1 of $2 KB used). Delete old sessions to keep syncing.

onboardingWelcome.message:
Welcome to TabNest!
Pin the icon to your toolbar to get started.
onboardingWelcome.description: First-run screen. Keep the line break.

tabsCount.description: Counter next to a session name, like "12 tabs".
